title: Three ENERGY sensors publish state class measurement, a pair HA declares impossible
claim: Lifetime Space Heating Energy, DHW Energy (lifetime) and Lifetime Total Energy publish device class energy with state class measurement (3 sensors), which Home Assistant's DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES forbids (energy admits only total/total_increasing), so HA logs the impossible-state-class warning and the recorder compiles mean statistics instead of a sum, keeping them out of the Energy dashboard the README says they feed.
mechanism: sensor._AccumulatingSensor declares _attr_state_class = SensorStateClass.MEASUREMENT although its own docstring calls it the base of the TOTAL_INCREASING accumulators; the three cost subclasses override to TOTAL, the three energy subclasses inherit MEASUREMENT. The entity-device-class row's done (D10-criteria Q2) fails at these three sites: the device class is declared but HA rejects the pair.

evidence.unit: sensors with a (device_class, state_class) pair HA's table forbids
evidence.machine: local macOS box B2 (orchestrator machine), Python 3.14 venv-ci
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count, contention-immune

metric_definition: impossible_pairs = sensors (all 62, via each platform's async_setup_entry) whose published device_class and state_class form a pair outside HA core's DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES
phenomenon_property: Every sensor's published (device_class, state_class) pair is one Home Assistant's DEVICE_CLASS_STATE_CLASSES admits; every lifetime kWh accumulator is total_increasing.
reproduction_steps: In HA core (homeassistant/components/sensor/entity.py) the state write logs 'is using state class measurement which is impossible considering device class (energy)'; sensor/recorder.py compiles mean/min/max for measurement, no sum.
proposed_fix_scope: sensor.py: _AccumulatingSensor's state class TOTAL_INCREASING (the cost subclasses keep TOTAL)
